scope: Source-only experimental action-conditioned factorized public predictive state; no original Farama/Pycolab worlds, no native integration or FSA first-use
input: Only exactly committed public uint8 before, own selected action 0,1,2, and returned public uint8 after; no session/world identity, future oracle, source-private reward/goal/hidden graph
mechanism: 24 independent (action,output_bit) learned causal factor cells, each selecting a 3-of-8 parent bit tuple from 56 known structural hypotheses by minimizing actual selected-transition bit error; all 8 observed parent configurations must have >=2 supports, best empirical bit error exactly 0 and runner-up error >=2 or abstain. Predict next public state by eight learned bit cells and multi-step compose only when every step is supported.
online: Update after each source-selected feedback. Keep exactly up to 192 most recent own-selected public before/after pairs per action, bounded 4096 total selected events. Episode boundaries do not reset learned feedback. Explicit FIFO truncation recorded. Contradictory recent transitions cause abstention until alternative regime's evidence displaces original window. No implicit world-name or reward-shaping.
qualified_fixtures: Source-authored deterministic 8-bit nonlinear three-parent public transition law from existing original R7 test_learner.py, with non-private seeds 11 (source-only developmental A) and 12 (source-only shift B). 192 distinct public states per action in each regime, divided into three separate publicly declared episodes of 64 each; hold remaining 64 source-authored inputs per action unused for fit. No new original-world source use.
strong_controls: Actually train unchanged exact R7 three-parent exhaustive local learner on exactly same 192 public transition pairs/action for A, and separately the most recent 192/action for B, with identical 3-parent structural hypothesis and query budget. Include exact-state Bayesian count learner and no-memory ablation. R7 control may tie; a tie is NO unique native advantage.
tests: Source-only cross-episode cold retention; action/feedback custody mismatch; no-support abstention; true unseen public single-step and 5-step composition; matched R7 and source-only exact-state counts; unfamiliar DYNAMICS within SAME authored synthetic family (NOT unfamiliar independent family); contradiction-induced abstention; limited-window recovery after 192 new selected outcomes/action; checkpoint external trusted digest and independent OS-process restore; corrupt/foreign identity rejected; bound CPU time/size at least source-only, not full system RSS; immutable original R7 reference.
negative: If strong R7 comparator ties, report trained-composition parity and no demonstrated unique native research gain. If learner ever predicts unsupported after/action, reports confidence during ambiguity, or exceeds controls' source rights, FAIL without retuning thresholds.
non_authority: No new source-world cohort, original-Farama/reset/step, native R7 source PR edit, FORGE F139 controller, scheduler, action queue, accepted model, first-use or merge. Overall general FORGE full CI mandatory independent.
